tests.name: Comprehensive Cancer Biomarker Panel
tests.tagline: Multi-tumor biomarker screening for early detection
tests.description: High-precision serum biomarker screen assessing risk factors for colorectal, liver, prostate, ovarian, and gastrointestinal malignancies.
tests.preparation: 10 to 12 hours fasting required. Morning sample recommended. Drink water freely.

tests.name: Avinya Whole Body Oncology & Metabolic Shield
tests.tagline: 72 Essential Parameters for full body health & cancer markers
tests.description: Our most comprehensive screening combining complete vital organ assessments (liver, kidney, heart, thyroid) with primary cancer markers.
testsIncluded: Renal & Kidney Profile with eGFR (8 Parameters)
Full Lipid & Cardiac Risk Profile (9 Parameters)
Vitamin D3 & Vitamin B12 Vital Levels
tests.preparation: 12 hours overnight fasting mandatory. Avoid alcohol and heavy exercise 24h prior.

tests.name: Liquid Biopsy & Circulating Tumor DNA Screen
tests.description: State-of-the-art circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA) analysis from a simple blood draw, identifying somatic gene mutations associated with multiple solid tumors.
testsIncluded: Circulating Tumor DNA Mutation Panel (EGFR, KRAS, BRAF, PIK3CA)
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Specialized DNA preservative tubes provided by trained phlebotomist.

tests.name: Advanced Cardiac Health & Stroke Risk Panel
tests.tagline: Preventive cardiology evaluation and lipid subfractionation
tests.description: Specialized cardiac profile assessing vascular inflammation, arterial plaque stability, and hereditary cardiovascular risk markers.
testsIncluded: Standard Lipid Profile (Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL, Triglycerides)
tests.preparation: 12 hours fasting. Avoid fatty meals the night before.

tests.name: Women's Comprehensive Wellness & Hormonal Profile
tests.tagline: Complete hormonal balance, fertility, and bone health assessment
tests.description: Designed specifically for women of all ages to evaluate hormonal harmony, thyroid metabolism, ovarian reserve, and anemia indices.
testsIncluded: Serum Ferritin & Total Iron Binding Capacity
tests.preparation: Fasting 8-10 hours. Best performed between Days 2-5 of menstrual cycle unless advised otherwise.

tests.name: Comprehensive Diabetic & Glycemic Control Check
tests.tagline: Precise 3-month glycemic control and microvascular organ checks
tests.description: Thorough evaluation of diabetes status, insulin resistance, urinary microalbuminuria, and early diabetic kidney detection.
testsIncluded: HbA1c (Glycosylated Hemoglobin) with Estimated Average Glucose
tests.preparation: Fasting 10 hours for fasting sample; 2nd draw 2 hours post meal.

tests.name: Senior Citizen Vitality & Bone Density Panel
tests.tagline: Tailored diagnostics for healthy aging, bone density, and memory
tests.description: Comprehensive health screen customized for individuals aged 60+ to detect joint degeneration, vitamin deficiencies, and organ health.
testsIncluded: PSA for Men / CA-125 for Women
tests.preparation: 10 to 12 hours fasting. Continue regular blood pressure medications with sips of water.

tests.name: Early Detection Mammography & Breast Ultrasound Referral
tests.tagline: Clinical digital imaging package at partner accredited diagnostic hubs
tests.description: Low-dose digital 3D tomosynthesis mammography and high-frequency bilateral breast ultrasound with expert radiologist BIRADS scoring.
testsIncluded: Bilateral Digital Full-Field Mammography (CC & MLO Views)
tests.preparation: Avoid applying deodorants, talcum powders, or lotions on chest or underarms on appointment day.
